rule_title: TTP 1550.002 - Pass the Hash - Logon Type 9 with Null GUID and Loopback Source
description: Detects Pass-the-Hash attacks via the canonical Mimikatz sekurlsa::pth fingerprint on EID 4624. LogonType 9 (NewCredentials) combined with a null LogonGuid, loopback source address, LogonProcessName of seclogo, and WorkstationName of '-' is the definitive Windows artifact of a locally-injected hash-based token.
